## `/fundadmin:fund ingest <folder>` {#ingest}

Classify & route a folder of mixed fund documents

Classifies a folder of mixed fund PDFs, routes each to its `/fundadmin:fund review-*` skill, runs reconciliation on matching pairs and the portfolio dashboard at 3+ funds. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund ingest` or drops a folder of GP portal PDFs.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund ingest <folder>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-ingest <folder>` |
| Codex | `$fund-ingest <folder>` |

**Writes** `INGEST-REPORT-[date].md` `INGEST-MANIFEST.md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund ingest-email <file>` {#ingest-email}

Parse email + attachments, cross-validate, extract action items

Parses an email or .eml and its attachments, then cross-validates the amounts, deadlines and fund names it claims against the documents to flag mismatches and wire fraud. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund ingest-email` or pastes a GP email with attachments.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund ingest-email <file>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-ingest-email <file>` |
| Codex | `$fund-ingest-email <file>` |

**Writes** `EMAIL-INGEST-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest-email/SKILL.md)
